mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) id,dimension_key source_channel,related_entity_id import_batch_id, source_row_id import_row_id,source_entity_id existing_source_id,metric_code reason,fact_status status, resolution_action,resolution_note,evaluation_time occurred_at,resolved_at,resolved_by FROM t_alert_occurrence WHERE occurrence_type='IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' AND fact_status=#{status} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_occurrence SET fact_status=#{status},resolution_action=#{action}, resolution_note=#{note},resolved_by=#{actor},resolved_at=NOW(3) WHERE occurrence_type='IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id)=#{id} AND fact_status='OPEN'
